How It Works

Simple customer flow.

1. Create Account

Register and verify your number with OTP.

2. UID Verify

Select SG/IND, enter UID and verify it.

3. Pay

Use Bank Transfer or your verified My Wallet.

4. Receipt

Track history and download your receipt.
